source.title: Urban Hydrology for Small Watersheds, Technical Release 55, Second Edition

context_note: TR-55 values were derived for US soils and US (SCS type I, IA, II, III) storms. They are used here for curve numbers, hydrologic soil groups and time-of-concentration hand checks. They are flagged 'literature' and must be confirmed for Bengaluru soils.

hsg._source: TR-55 Appendix A, p. A-1 (Musgrave 1955 transmission rates, converted from in/hr)

A.description: Deep, well to excessively drained sand or gravel. Low runoff potential.

B.description: Moderately deep to deep, moderately well to well drained, moderately fine to moderately coarse textures.

C.description: A layer that impedes downward movement of water, or moderately fine to fine texture.

D.description: Clays with high swelling potential, permanent high water table, claypan, or shallow soil over nearly impervious material. High runoff potential.

disturbed_soil_texture_hsg._source: TR-55 Appendix A, p. A-1 (Brakensiek and Rawls 1983); applies when the profile is disturbed and not significantly compacted

curve_numbers._note: Average antecedent runoff condition, Ia = 0.2S. 'pervious' covers can be used for the pervious part of a SWMM subcatchment. 'composite' covers already include an assumed impervious share and are for hand checks only.

open_space_poor.label: Open space (lawns, parks), poor condition, grass cover < 50 %

open_space_fair.label: Open space (lawns, parks), fair condition, grass cover 50-75 %

open_space_good.label: Open space (lawns, parks), good condition, grass cover > 75 %

newly_graded.label: Newly graded area, pervious, no vegetation

meadow.label: Meadow, continuous grass, protected from grazing, mowed

brush_good.label: Brush-weed-grass mixture, good (> 75 % ground cover)
brush_good.note: Group A value is < 30; TR-55 says use 30.

woods_good.label: Woods, good (protected, litter and brush cover soil)
woods_good.note: Group A value is < 30; TR-55 says use 30.

impervious.label: Paved parking, roofs, driveways; paved streets with curbs and storm drains

street_open_ditch.label: Paved street with open ditches (including right-of-way)

residential_town_houses.label: Residential, 1/8 acre (~500 m2) lots or less, town houses (65 % impervious)

sheet_flow_n._source: TR-55 Table 3-1, p. 3-3 (Engman 1986). For sheet flow depths of about 0.03 m only.

smooth.label: Smooth surfaces (concrete, asphalt, gravel, bare soil)
